After the fix, extractIdentityClaim no longer produces an identity claim for that sentence -- this fixture asserts whatever the real engine now gives with the false-switch cause removed; it is NOT forced to STAGE (the two knowledge-check FAILs on the invoice-reference question are a separate, unscoped-fact issue this lane does not touch -- see the file header comment for the rule).
